stances.summary: Accuses Trump White House of unprecedented corruption
stances.quote:
Raw, unabashed, unembarrassed corruption coming straight from the White House. 
 
It's unlike anything we’ve ever seen from an American president.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of using White House for personal financial gain
stances.quote:
The White House should not be the President's personal piggy bank. 
 
What we are witnessing from this president is blatant corruption. Plain and simple.

stances.summary: Calls for immediate firing of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
stances.quote: Pete Hegseth should be fired immediately.

stances.summary: Criticizes taxpayer costs of Air Force One renovations under Trump
stances.quote: The "free" Qatari Air Force One has cost us God only knows how much to renovate. Why are we paying for Donald Trump to pimp his ride?

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of $2 billion personal profiteering while in office
stances.quote: Donald Trump has profited over $2 billion while in office. Talk about waste, fraud, and abuse.

stances.summary: Blames Trump for measles resurgence and other national crises
stances.quote:
Measles is back. 
War in the Middle East. 
Mortgage rates at new highs. 
 
Donald Trump is a failed President.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of graft, measles outbreaks, and healthcare cost increases
stances.quote:
Donald Trump is breaking records. 
 
For grift, measles cases, and health care premiums.

stances.summary: Declares Trump a failed president who broke campaign promises
stances.quote:
Donald Trump has broken nearly every promise he made.

He is a failed president.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of dismantling democratic institutions and national foundations
stances.quote:
Donald Trump and his cronies are trying to dismantle this country, strip down everything that makes us great, and sell it for parts. 
 
They are arsonists. We will not let them burn down our democracy.

stances.summary: Expresses disapproval of Trump administration actions or norms
stances.quote: This is not normal.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for monetizing early social media access to wealthy supporters
stances.quote:
This isn't getting enough attention. 
 
Donald Trump is selling early access to his Truth Social posts for $100,000 per month. 
 
What purpose does this serve except to enrich the President and his wealthy friends? It's patently unfair.

stances.summary: Opposes Todd Blanche's Attorney General confirmation as Trump loyalist
stances.quote:
I just voted NO on confirming Todd Blanche to be the next Attorney General.

The President's personal lawyer should not be America's lawyer.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump tax cuts, condemns food insecurity as moral failure
stances.quote:
Millions of families are going hungry because Trump decided another tax cut for his billionaire buddies was more important. 
 
It is a moral catastrophe.

stances.summary: Advocates higher taxes on billionaires, limits on campaign spending
stances.quote: We need billionaires to spend more on taxes and less on elections.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for cutting food assistance programs
stances.quote: Donald Trump keeps saying he’s “lifted people off of food stamps.” He didn’t lift anyone off of anything. He cut the program and took food away from people.

stances.summary: Secured tariff restrictions, criticizes Trump's tariff policy as reckless
stances.quote:
Tonight, I secured a key concession from the Trump admin to close a loophole in the Russia sanctions bill that expanded Trump’s tariff power. 

This is a small but important victory for all Americans who have suffered under this President’s reckless tariffs.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump tax cuts for billionaires, blames hunger on policy priorities
stances.quote:
We can’t lose sight of this.

Millions of families are going hungry in this country because Donald Trump wanted to give a tax break to billionaires.

It’s a moral abomination.

stances.summary: Opposes child hunger in wealthy nation, calls for policy change
stances.quote: Children should not be going hungry in the richest nation on earth. It doesn’t have to be this way.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump administration's economic record as complete failure
stances.quote:
Donald Trump's economy is a complete and total failure. 

It's been nearly two years, and his administration is still blaming Joe Biden!

stances.summary: Criticizes policies for raising costs
stances.quote: All he does is make things more expensive.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump tax cuts for billionaires as shifting burden to children
stances.quote: Donald Trump handed billionaires a tax cut but left our children with the bill.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump's economic policies as disastrous
stances.quote: This economy is a disaster of Trump’s own making.

stances.summary: Criticizes spending priorities favoring Trump over healthcare funding
stances.quote:
We're told that we just don't have the money for health care. But apparently we have plenty of money to upgrade Trump's private jet.

We don't suffer from a lack of resources. We suffer from a lack of moral imagination.

stances.summary: Criticizes Elon Musk's reliance on government subsidies
stances.quote: If you received as many government handouts and subsidies as Elon Musk has, you'd be super rich too.

stances.summary: Calls for higher billionaire taxes and reduced campaign spending
stances.quote: We need billionaires to spend more on taxes and less on elections.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump's financial profiteering and government waste
stances.quote: Donald Trump has profited over $2 billion while in office. Talk about waste, fraud, and abuse.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for profiting from presidency and billionaire corruption
stances.quote:
Trump has made BILLIONS off of the presidency.

And if you’re one of his billionaire buddies, you’re profiting off of it too.

This is raw, unabashed corruption unlike anything we’ve seen from an American president.

stances.summary: Billionaires should prioritize tax contributions over election spending
stances.quote: Billionaires should be spending less on elections and more in taxes.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for profiting from presidency, converting White House to personal benefit
stances.quote:
Trump has made billions of dollars from being president. 

He's turned the White House into his personal piggy bank.

stances.summary: Honors Emmett Till's memory, commits to fighting racism
stances.quote: 71 years ago, an act of racism, hate, and violence took Emmett Till’s bright young life. Today, I’m remembering him and his mother, Mamie Till-Mobley. May God continue to bless their memory. We must continue our fight to end racism and hate in every form.

stances.summary: Calls for fighting to preserve voting rights as essential to democracy
stances.quote:
Democracy is the very house we live in. It is the whole game. 
 
That is why voting rights are so important. We must fight tooth and nail to preserve them.

stances.summary: Condemns Supreme Court gutting of Voting Rights Act, calls for restoration
stances.quote:
61 years ago, the Voting Rights Act became law thanks to the hard work and perseverance of civil rights activists. 
 
This year, Trump’s Supreme Court gutted it. They are playing with the blood of our ancestors. 
 
Honor their legacy. Pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement

stances.summary: Demands congressional investigation of racial gerrymandering by state officials
stances.quote:
We must drag every state official who manipulated their maps to silence Black voters before Congress, and we've got to investigate if any illegal racial discrimination took place. 

We deserve answers.

stances.summary: Honors Black military service and sacrifice against historical discrimination
stances.quote: This Buffalo Soldiers Day, I’m thinking of the first all-Black Army regiments formed after the Civil War. Despite facing discrimination and hate, these brave soldiers served our country valiantly. The patriotism and sacrifice of these heroes live on.

stances.summary: Opposes Trump vote-by-mail restrictions, calls for court reform
stances.quote: With his vicious attack on vote by mail, Donald Trump is already trying to stop everyday Americans from voting in the midterms and the Supreme Court is helping him.  We must defeat him and reform the court.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of attempting 2026 election interference
stances.quote:
Donald Trump is trying to interfere in the 2026 elections.

We must not let him succeed.

stances.summary: Opposes SAVE Act as voter suppression through bureaucratic barriers
stances.quote:
The entire goal of the SAVE Act is to put a mountain of paperwork between you and the ballot box.  
 
They want to suppress the vote with bureaucracy.

stances.summary: Announces voting rights plan, criticizes inaction, calls for immediate action
stances.quote:
I just rolled out a comprehensive plan to fix and strengthen voting rights in America. 

For too long, we’ve sat on our hands while this problem just gets worse and worse. 

Enough talk. It’s past time for action.

stances.summary: Demands Democrats prioritize voting rights legislation when holding power
stances.quote:
Read the plan here: warnock.senate.gov/the-futur…

Link



THE FUTURE OF VOTING RIGHTS IN AMERICA » Reverend Raphael Warnock

The Future of Voting Rights in America No more excuses: as soon as Democrats hold a trifecta, protecting voting rights must be at the top of the agenda. I

stances.summary: Opposes Trump food stamp cuts, denies claims of lifting people off assistance
stances.quote:
Don't let Trump convince you that he has “lifted people off of food stamps.” He cut the program and took food AWAY from people. 
 
He didn’t lift anyone off of anything.

stances.summary: Claims Trump failed to deliver on campaign promises
stances.quote:
Donald Trump has broken nearly every promise he made.

He is a failed president.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of dismantling democratic institutions and national foundations
stances.quote:
Donald Trump and his cronies are trying to dismantle this country, strip down everything that makes us great, and sell it for parts. 
 
They are arsonists. We will not let them burn down our democracy.

stances.summary: Blames Trump for measles outbreak, Middle East conflict, rising mortgage rates
stances.quote:
Measles is back. 
War in the Middle East. 
Mortgage rates at new highs. 
 
Donald Trump is a failed President.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump record on grift, disease outbreaks, healthcare costs
stances.quote:
Donald Trump is breaking records. 
 
For grift, measles cases, and health care premiums.

stances.summary: Demands universal healthcare access for all Americans
stances.quote:
Millions of people can’t afford health care in the wealthiest nation on earth. 
 
Don’t let them convince you that this is the best we can do. 
 
We can and we MUST ensure every American has health care.

stances.summary: Calls for RFK Jr.'s removal, opposing his health policy influence
stances.quote: RFK Jr. is a hazard to our health. He must be fired.

stances.summary: Calls for firing RFK Jr. over measles outbreak response
stances.quote:
Enough is enough. 
 
Measles cases keep breaking new records and all our Health Secretary has done is pour fuel on the fire. 
 
RFK Jr. must be fired immediately.

stances.summary: Supports capping insulin costs at $35, demands immediate vote
stances.quote: GOOD NEWS: My bill to cap the cost of insulin at $35 is officially moving forward. It's well past time to get this done. Let’s call this up for a full vote ASAP.

stances.summary: Opposes Trump's Iran military action as reckless and illegal
stances.quote:
I just voted to end President Trump's war in Iran.

This reckless and illegal war has left us worse off. It has been a failure of leadership to the highest degree.

stances.summary: Opposes $67 billion Iran war spending, prioritizes domestic needs
stances.quote:
Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth want $67 BILLION to continue their illegal war in Iran.

Imagine if we spent that money on health care or helped Americans buy their first home?

stances.summary: Blames abortion bans for preventable maternal death, opposes restrictions
stances.quote: Four years ago today, Amber Thurman died because politicians put politics over the health of Georgia mothers. Amber’s death was preventable. This anniversary is a painful reminder that abortion bans have fatal consequences. May her memory be a blessing.

stances.summary: Opposes corporate data center expansion without community input
stances.quote:
Big corporations are running roughshod over small communities, building massive data centers with no input from the people who live there.
 
In many cases, it’s driving up the cost of utilities. It’s causing pollution. And it’s often being done in secret.
 
It has to stop. https:

stances.summary: Expresses concern about school shooting, emphasizes community support
stances.quote: I’m closely following reports of a shooting at Warner Robins High School. My prayers are with the two students who were injured, their families, and the entire Warner Robins community. I’m grateful to the law enforcement officers and first responders on the scene.

stances.summary: Commemorates attack victim, calls for worker safety protections
stances.quote: On the one year anniversary of the horrific attack on CDC's Atlanta headquarters, I'm praying for Officer David Rose’s family and recognizing the devastation faced by the entire CDC community. We must ensure CDC employees have the support necessary to do their jobs without fear o

stances.summary: Criticizes war spending prioritized over child nutrition programs
stances.quote: Those in power told us there was no money to feed hungry children. Only to turn around and immediately spend billions on war.

stances.summary: Criticizes administration vaccine undermining; warns reckless rhetoric has deadly consequences
stances.quote:
This admin has undermined vaccines at every turn. 
 
Now, measles cases are breaking new records. 
 
Reckless rhetoric has deadly consequences.

stances.summary: Criticizes House Republicans for voting to cut food assistance to poor families
stances.quote:
House Republicans held hands in prayer as they voted to take food away from hungry families. 

How can you pray for your neighbor, and then literally turn around and prey ON your neighbor with policies that crush the poor.
